title: Rename {{name}}
quotedHint: In the script it is written as {{quoted}} (quoted, to keep case or special characters).
collides: An object named “{{name}}” already exists: the engine will reject the change.
keepViewColumns: Keep the view column names (new AS old)
reading: Looking for what depends on {{name}} and reading their definitions…
same: Enter a name different from the current one.
summary: {{rewrite}} will be rewritten, {{engine}} are updated by the engine and {{manual}} need manual attention ({{scanned}} definitions read).
outside: Other databases, applications and external reports are not checked: anything that uses the old name outside this database will stop working.
unreadable: Could not read the definition of: {{names}}. Anything that depends on the object there is not rewritten.
atomic: The script runs in a transaction: if a statement fails, nothing changes.
notAtomic: This engine does not roll back structure changes: if a statement fails, what came before stays done. Review the script before running it.

groupHint.rewrite: DBine changes the name in their code and recreates them with the script. Uncheck the ones you prefer to edit by hand.
groupHint.engine: Keys, indexes and objects the engine follows on its own: nothing to do.
groupHint.manual: DBine does not change them: review them after renaming.

tracked: followed by the engine on its own
reviewHint: Part of the text could not be decided: if you check it, those lines stay as they are.
schemabound: with SCHEMABINDING: dropped first and created afterwards

manualReason.dynamic: dynamic SQL: the name appears inside a string
manualReason.unreadable: its definition could not be read
manualReason.not_rewritten: this engine does not rewrite this kind of reference
manualReason.no_match: the text does not name it in a way DBine recognizes
manualReason.shared_routine: it is also run by triggers on other tables: its NEW and OLD are not only from this table

reason.other_schema: no schema, in an object of another schema
reason.case: unquoted, it may refer to another object (upper and lower case)
reason.maybe_function: followed by “(”: it may be a function with the same name
reason.ambiguous_column: column without a table in a statement that reads several
reason.alias_named_like_schema: there is an alias named like the schema

nothing: Nothing in the database depends on this object: the script only renames it.
prodConfirm: This is a production connection. Type {{name}} to confirm.
rolledBack: Nothing changed: the whole script was rolled back.
queryTabs_one: There is {{count}} open query tab that names “{{name}}”: it was not modified.
queryTabs_other: There are {{count}} open query tabs that name “{{name}}”: they were not modified.
